column2:
warehouse(n./v.)倉庫、存入倉庫
(無詞性變化)
warehouse store 倉儲量販店
storage warehouse 儲藏倉庫
The online shop ships all its products from a huge warehouse.
(那家網路商店的所有商品都從一座巨大的倉庫出貨。)
Many families do their monthly shopping at warehouse stores.
(許多家庭在倉儲量販店採買每月所需。)

warrior(n.)戰士、勇士
(無詞性變化)
brave warrior 英勇的戰士
road warrior 經常出差的人
The ancient warriors fought bravely to protect their land.
(古代戰士英勇作戰以保衛家園。)
She is a true warrior who never gives up in hard times.
(她是個真正的勇士，在艱困時從不放棄。)

wary(adj.)小心翼翼的、謹慎的、提防的
warily(adv.)謹慎地
be wary of 提防
wary eye 警戒的眼光
You should be wary of strangers who ask for personal information online.
(你應該提防在網路上索取個人資料的陌生人。)
The cat kept a wary eye on the dog in the yard.
(那隻貓警戒地盯著院子裡的狗。)

weird(adj.)怪異的、奇怪的
weirdness(n.)怪異
weird feeling 奇怪的感覺
weird noise 怪聲
I heard a weird noise coming from the kitchen last night.
(昨晚我聽到廚房傳來一陣怪聲。)
It feels weird to be back at my old school after so many years.
(這麼多年後回到母校感覺很奇怪。)

whatsoever(adj./pron.)任何的、絲毫(用於加強否定)
whatever(pron./adj.)無論什麼
no doubt whatsoever 毫無疑問
nothing whatsoever 什麼也沒有
There is no evidence whatsoever that he stole the money.
(完全沒有證據顯示他偷了那筆錢。)
I have no interest whatsoever in watching horror movies.
(我對看恐怖片一點興趣也沒有。)

wheelchair(n.)輪椅
(無詞性變化)
in a wheelchair 坐輪椅
wheelchair access 無障礙通道
The new library provides wheelchair access at every entrance.
(新圖書館的每個入口都設有無障礙通道。)
After the accident, he had to use a wheelchair for several months.
(事故後，他有好幾個月必須坐輪椅。)

whereabouts(n./adv.)下落、行蹤、在哪裡
(無詞性變化)
current whereabouts 目前下落
whereabouts unknown 下落不明
The police are still trying to find out the whereabouts of the missing hiker.
(警方仍在設法查明失蹤登山客的下落。)
Whereabouts in Taipei do you live?
(你住在台北的哪一帶？)

whereas(conj.)然而、反之
(無詞性變化)
whereas others 而其他人
whereas in the past 而在過去
Some students prefer studying at night, whereas others focus better in the morning.
(有些學生喜歡晚上讀書，而其他人則在早上比較專心。)
My brother loves sports, whereas I prefer reading.
(我哥哥熱愛運動，而我比較喜歡閱讀。)

whine(n./v.)抱怨、哀鳴、嘎吱聲
whiny(adj.)愛發牢騷的
whine about 抱怨
the whine of 的尖銳聲音
Stop whining about the homework and just get it done.
(別再抱怨功課了，趕快把它寫完。)
We could hear the high-pitched whine of a mosquito in the dark.
(黑暗中我們能聽到蚊子尖銳的嗡嗡聲。)

widespread(adj.)廣泛的、普遍的
(無詞性變化)
widespread use 廣泛使用
widespread support 廣泛支持
The widespread use of smartphones has changed how we communicate.
(智慧型手機的普及改變了我們溝通的方式。)
The new policy received widespread support from parents.
(這項新政策獲得家長廣泛支持。)

wig(n.)假髮
(無詞性變化)
wear a wig 戴假髮
curly wig 捲髮假髮
The actor wore a gray wig to play an old man in the play.
(那位演員戴上灰色假髮在戲中飾演老人。)
Judges in Britain traditionally wear white wigs in court.
(英國的法官傳統上在法庭上戴白色假髮。)

wilderness(n.)荒野、荒地
wild(adj.)野生的
in the wilderness 在荒野中
wilderness area 荒野保護區
The hikers got lost in the wilderness for two days.
(那些登山客在荒野中迷路了兩天。)
Some people enjoy camping in the wilderness far from the city.
(有些人喜歡在遠離城市的荒野中露營。)

wildlife(n.)野生動物
(無詞性變化)
wildlife conservation 野生動物保育
wildlife park 野生動物園
Plastic waste in the ocean is a serious threat to wildlife.
(海洋中的塑膠垃圾對野生動物是嚴重威脅。)
The national park is home to a rich variety of wildlife.
(這座國家公園是多種野生動物的棲息地。)

windshield(n.)擋風玻璃
windscreen(n.)擋風玻璃(英式)
windshield wipers 雨刷
cracked windshield 破裂的擋風玻璃
A small stone hit the car and cracked the windshield.
(一顆小石頭擊中車子，把擋風玻璃打裂了。)
Turn on the windshield wipers when it starts to rain.
(開始下雨時要打開雨刷。)

wither(v.)枯萎、凋謝、衰弱
withered(adj.)枯萎的
wither away 逐漸消亡
withered leaves 枯葉
The flowers withered because no one watered them.
(那些花因為沒人澆水而枯萎了。)
Without community support, the old tradition may wither away.
(少了社區的支持，這項老傳統可能會逐漸消失。)

witty(adj.)機智的、詼諧的
wit(n.)機智
wittily(adv.)機智地
witty remark 妙語
witty speech 風趣的演說
Everyone laughed at the speaker's witty remarks.
(大家都被講者的妙語逗笑了。)
Our English teacher is witty and always makes class fun.
(我們的英文老師很風趣，總是讓課堂很有趣。)

workshop(n.)工作坊、研討會、工作室
(無詞性變化)
attend a workshop 參加工作坊
writing workshop 寫作工作坊
Our school held a workshop on how to prepare for college interviews.
(我們學校舉辦了一場準備大學面試的工作坊。)
My grandfather builds furniture in his small workshop.
(我爺爺在他的小工作室裡做家具。)

worship(n./v.)崇拜、禮拜
worshipper(n.)崇拜者、禮拜者
place of worship 禮拜場所
ancestor worship 祭祖
Many families in Taiwan practice ancestor worship during festivals.
(台灣許多家庭在節日時祭拜祖先。)
Some fans worship their idols and copy everything they do.
(有些粉絲崇拜偶像，模仿他們的一舉一動。)

worthwhile(adj.)值得的、有價值的
worth(adj./n.)值得的、價值
worthwhile experience 值得的經驗
make it worthwhile 讓……值得
Volunteering at the animal shelter was a worthwhile experience.
(在動物收容所當志工是一次很有意義的經驗。)
It is worthwhile to spend time learning a second language.
(花時間學習第二外語是值得的。)

worthy(adj.)值得的、有價值的、可敬的
worth(adj./n.)值得的、價值
be worthy of 值得
worthy cause 有意義的目標
Her brave actions are worthy of our respect.
(她英勇的行為值得我們尊敬。)
The students raised money for a worthy cause.
(學生們為一項有意義的公益目標募款。)

yacht(n./v.)遊艇、駕遊艇
yachting(n.)遊艇運動
luxury yacht 豪華遊艇
yacht club 遊艇俱樂部
The billionaire spent his vacation sailing on a luxury yacht.
(那位億萬富翁搭著豪華遊艇度假。)
Kaohsiung is known for building high-quality yachts.
(高雄以製造高品質遊艇聞名。)

yield(v./n.)產生、出產、屈服、讓路、產量
(無詞性變化)
yield to 屈服於、讓路給
crop yield 作物產量
Drivers must yield to pedestrians at crosswalks.
(駕駛人在斑馬線前必須禮讓行人。)
The new farming method increased crop yields by twenty percent.
(新的耕作方法使作物產量提高了百分之二十。)
